content: Kaliniyas mbe Bitlus bi
A Kaisaliya i pǝl mulǝn mul shin Kaliniyas, mul kumti nǝ gawasi age' mi' dobga ki sojoji gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti ki dobga ki Ataliya.
Ti mulbǝlt Lya kǝni nǝ ɓulti Lya nǝ mbalǝn ki libiwasi ti bǝlt mbalǝn ulkǝ toh wasi nǝ mbalt nǝm, ati shilǝn ngwash ngwash nǝ Lya.
Gason dom maki ki su'ti, i' en mul shinkǝn ki Lya age' tluti, immbǝ i' ultisu, ki “Kaliniyas!”
Kaliniyas utti dwaɗǝn nǝ ɓanti, i' usu mulban yakǝni? I mul shinkǝn ki Lya ultisu, shilǝn nǝ Lya nǝ bǝlti wagi a mbǝ kina ɗǝ Lya i.
Nǝ gun u pǝl shinkǝn swa Yapa sǝ' taki Saminu bi gunǝ si mbetti ki Bitlus su.
Ishiti ma' Saminu mul motti bati guna libi was nja ma' bal malu.”
Nǝ mul shinkǝn ki Lya nǝ shin nitu zǝga u, i Kaniliyas taki zheli was lob bi, nǝ mul kǝndǝtl dlomon mul bǝtl shilǝn ki Lya ge' ginǝ ɗǝ pǝlliti kyautǝn hu gasi u kǝni.
Nǝdl dlimisi mus ulnǝ nda u is shinsi tya Yapa.
Lucili a dloncin ɓal nja i, sǝ ɓal nja nǝ gatlu ngu, i Bitlus toge' kǝpsi ki lya ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya.
Kuzǝn a gobti, ti lyap ɗamti, amma ɗǝ pǝtl ulki ɗami i, i tluti mbiti.
I'en lya a ɓuli, ulǝn ɗǝ sussuɗi kǝnǝ bal ul idlam mbalǝn, ɗǝ shitti su' atli ge' zheltwas upsi.
A giɓi mus lǝɓa ki dǝlgǝn nǝki ban, nǝmi' dǝtl tugi, nǝ gala'sa nǝ yadli.
I yalon ultisu, “Bitlus hilya, ki' poci a' ɗami.”
Amma i Bitlus usu o o, a ɗam bezǝn ulǝn gason wai ko ulnǝ bǝ mbunwai u.
I' kum yali ɗaɗanu, ki lop, usu, “Ulnǝ Lya a li'ni' u, bǝ palli besniwai.”
I gu pǝ asǝn maki, alǝbǝ alǝbǝ i dǝl ulisi twalya.
Uli ɗǝ hwotti Bitlus kǝn ngu tǝn tlutu nǝs pǝlitu, iki i mbalǝn i nǝ Kaliniyas shinsi teɗu, tǝn dlabi, sa lǝge sa ngem libi ki Saminu i.
Is tabi is ngemi Saminu gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti ki Bitlus nǝn ɗawa.
Tun a Bitlus ɗǝ dambǝtlti tǝn tlutu, i Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ultisu, “I ngu mbalǝn maki ɗǝ ngauki.
Hilya ki' pe'swai, ki bǝlsi kali. Bǝkum ɓantwai, gaki ami shinsi teɗi.
I Bitlus pe'swa ma' mbalǝni, i' ulsisu, “Ami ki ngautǝma. Ya mbǝlkini?”

Mbalǝni usu, “Mǝ mbǝni te'ma' ndǝl mulǝn mul kina ki mil kǝndǝ dlom gǝni ɗǝ mbetti ki Kaliniyas, mul zo' mbadli, mul ɓanti Lya, gunǝ mus mbalǝn ki Yahudawa ɗǝ ndwa'titi, mul shinkǝn ki Lya mul gunti ultisu, ti ta shinkǝn, ki lǝ libi ɗakka, tǝ' kum ulnǝ ki' dlimi u.”
I Bitlus mbǝlsi a libini. Nǝ lucilu i' hilya is zǝga ne'si is dǝm sǝmbǝlswasi, ge' mi' bǝtl Yesu kal ki Yapa is la'ti shitu.
Lucili im mbǝkǝci a Kaisaliya. Kaliniyas ɗǝ la'ti mbatl ki mbǝ twasǝn, im mbe yelsǝni bi nǝ yelǝnsi wasi.
Bitlus ɗǝ te' libi ni ngu, i Kaliniyas njeti in nda kina ɗa'ka, in nalti.
Amma i Bitlus tlǝlti lya, i' usu, “Hilya, amima yakǝn mbalǝn kǝni.”
Nǝ Bitlus ɗǝ shilǝn situ, it te' giɓi in mbi mbalǝn diɓǝli a domga i.
I' ulsisu, “Kini nǝ gawakǝn ki manini, a mbunwai tǝ mul Yahudiya maga ko sǝl le' shinni mulnǝ bǝ biwas kǝn wai u. Amma Lya a mboki toh ba ul mulǝnsu mul bezǝn mbadlwai, ko mul ulkǝ ci'zhentwai.
Gaki nǝgu, nǝs ta shinkǝn ta mbǝ u, a ngewai. To nǝgun ami lyamti ta kumi ya laki i' takinǝn biɗa.”
I Kaliniyas usu, “Asǝti mutti maki ngu, lu nǝguni, ami shilǝn nǝ Lya ki dom maki ki su'ti a libi ɗa ka, bǝnǝ mantiwai sai mulǝn kǝn ngu ki dlili nǝ hwol lulǝgǝl akina ɗa ka.
I muli usu, Kaliniyas, Lya akum shilǝn nǝtiwagi, bǝlti wagi a dǝm ulki dambǝlti akina ɗǝ Lya.
Gaki nǝgu a' shin shinkǝ tya Yapa ti taki Saminu bi, gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti ki Bitlus su, am mbǝ a libi ɗǝ Saminu mul pǝtl bati abi bal mal.’
Alǝbi alǝbi ya taki' shinkǝn, a mbuni ni' mbǝ u, to nǝguni i ngu mus ma mbǝ a kina ɗǝ Lya i, gaki tǝn kum undi zhili u nǝ Lya piku.”
I Bitlus pisi i' usu “Nǝgun amani balini Lya ɗa nge mbalǝnwai.
Amma mus mbalǝn milɓantiti nǝ mul pǝl ulki zoki ulkǝ kamini amatti.
Lya ta shinkǝn tu'ma' mbalǝn ki Isilaila, asi pitsi shilǝn multǝmti ki holtugi tu'ma' Yesu Almasihu, tikǝ Lya kǝ kowagi.
Kǝmanǝn shilǝn u nǝ dla'ga age' alt ki Yahudiya, tun te' Galili kal ki pǝli' mbalǝn batisma ki Yahaya atipi' mbalǝn shilǝn ki Lya
mǝkum shilǝn ki Yesu Banazalat gunǝ Lya swati nǝ Yal ki mbalt ki Lya kǝ zoki mul ndǝltti, i' gobduti ati pǝtl ulkǝ zoki, ati ndokǝl mus ginǝ sheɗan ɗǝ bǝlsi kalu gaki Lya matti.
Mine mi'enti nǝ dwaɗǝkǝni ki Yesu nǝ mus ulnǝ pǝli age' alt ki Yahudiya nǝ Ulshelima u. Iki is tlotti atǝn gadlǝtga,
Amma i Lya tlǝti age' mutti maki i' mbǝlgawas ge' mbalǝn.
Ma' mbalǝn mus kǝn tǝ mbǝlgawa swai, se mami' enti nǝ dwaɗǝnwasi ginǝ Lya oli tun te'ɗi wato mini u nǝn ɗamini i' tle ne' tu kal ki hilyawas ge' mi'mǝshti.
Ippimini tǝn dlǝmi mbalǝn shilǝn ki Lya, mini ne mi'enti nǝ dwaɗǝnwaskǝni tǝn ti Lya latti mul pǝli' mbalǝn mi'dli nǝ mi'mǝshti shilǝn.
Mus milnjeshinkǝn is pǝl enti nǝ dwaɗǝn ɗǝ ussu tu' ma shin wasi mus mulnǝ alambatl tu' ma'tu tǝn mbi' pekǝlti.”
Bitlus age' shilǝn kǝngu, i Yal ki mbatl ki Lya i nde mus mi' kubti suɗi.
I Yahudawa mi' ndǝti nǝ sǝlkǝn is mbǝ ne' Bitlus su is kub gagashiti hal ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u is mbi bǝlti ki Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ki gunti.
Ama is kubmi si shilǝn nǝ bi diɓǝli asi natl Lya. I Bitlus usu,
“Mul ma' hana pǝlit mbalǝn i baptisma nǝ mal nǝn ɗaya? Sima sa mbi Yal ki mbalt ki Lya i kan u nǝn mbini u.”
I Bitlus bǝlsi zhil sǝpǝlisi Baptisma age' shin ki Yesu Almasihu is ngemti tǝdǝm kǝ mutti lob ne' si.
